title: Login with a session cookie or JWT

objectives.text: Compare a session cookie and a JWT for a single-page app: where the credential is kept, how it is sent, and the cross-site scripting and cross-site request forgery trade-offs
Submit a login form, handle success and failure, and keep the signed-in user in application state
Send the credential on later requests: credentials: 'include' for a cookie, or an Authorization: Bearer header for a JWT
